item.description: El monumental informe oficial sobre los atentados del 11-S concluyó que la ofensiva terrorista sin precedentes que Al Qaida perpetró en 2001 fue posible por «un fallo de imaginación». item.description: Imagine que intenta crear el enemigo perfecto para atormentar la imaginación europea. Este enemigo inventado sería un país muy grande, tal vez adherido a la misma ideología comunista que durante décadas encadenó a Europa oriental. Una némesis imaginaria así habría aprovechado el peso de su economía planificada para exportar exactamente los mismos productos que en su día enriquecieron a Europa, como los coches, pero haciéndolos mejores y más baratos. item.description: As flight FZ 1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv approached the Jordanian border on Wednesday, passengers knew in an instant that something was wrong when the plane began plummeting from the sky in a rapid dive. item.title: Meet 'America': Trump’s AI chatbot changes answers after challenging his claims
item.description: Donald Trump has launched “America”, an AI chatbot designed as a digital portal for US government information. But its responses appear to be changing. The chatbot initially challenged several of Trump’s claims, including on the 2020 election and inflation, providing evidence and links. More recently, it has refused to answer some of the same questions. Other responses still contradict Trump, while some echo his views. item.title: UK PM Burnham says may rejoin EU; France, Spain say 'welcome back'
item.description: French president, speaking alongside Spanish counterpart Pedro Sánchez, says EU bid would be good news for UK and Europeans UK politics live – latest updates The French president, Emmanuel Macron, has reacted warmly to Andy Burnham’s suggestion that the UK could rejoin the EU. “Welcome back,” the French leader said in English with a smile at a news conference in Madrid on Wednesday. Macron continued in French: “If the British want to come back and if the prime minister is moving in that direction, I think that is very good news, both for his country and for the Europeans.” Continue reading... item.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant exchange deal is scrapped
item.description: A British-French agreement aimed at reducing the number of people trying to cross the English Channel in small boats has been scrapped, London said Wednesday. The pilot programme was intended to break the business model of "people smugglers" by exchanging undocumented migrants who had made the crossing for people who legally applied for asylum. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: UK-France deal targeting migrants crossing English Channel is scrapped
item.description: A pilot programme between the UK and France that aimed to curb the number of migrants crossing the English Channel in small boats has been scrapped, Britain’s government said on Wednesday. In a statement, the Home Office said the so-called “one in, one out” deal is “no longer processing new cases”. Under the plan, people who arrived in the UK after making the dangerous crossing across the Channel could be detained and returned to France in exchange for an equivalent number of asylum seekers who... item.title: Elecciones en Brasil: las favelas en Río de Janeiro, un electorado clave en la disputa por el voto
item.description: Más de 2,1 millones de personas viven en las favelas del estado de Río de Janeiro. Campaña, promesas, movilizaciones para animar a la población a votar: a pocos días de la primera vuelta de las elecciones generales en Brasil, que se celebran el domingo 4 de octubre, los habitantes de las favelas constituyen, para muchos candidatos, un electorado al que hay que seducir. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: France to unveil 2027 budget as debt hits record high
item.description: As the French government prepares to unveil its latest budget, the country's debt is at a record high and growing every day. France's public debt currently stands at nearly 3.6 trillion euros, nearly 60 billion of that added in the last three months alone. Fuente: France 24 - English.
